outcome.Summary: Implemented `cmd/report` (package main) with `run(args, in, out)`: parses `--by region|product` and `--top N` flags, reads the CSV header to locate required columns in any order (erroring on missing ones), validates qty (integer ≥ 0) and price (≤ 2 decimals, converted to integer cents) with 1-based line numbers via csv.FieldPos, aggregates per group, sorts by revenue descending / name ascending, prints groups plus a TOTAL over all rows with exactly 2 decimals. Added 18 tests in main_test.go covering the example output, aggregation, sorting/ties, --top, column reordering/extra columns, missing columns, bad values, zero/empty input, cent arithmetic without float drift, flag errors, and write-error propagation. Verified `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes and the example CLI run matches the spec.
